name: Vancouver (United States)
description: Divided by a white chevron-shaped band into a green upper hoist for the forests and a blue lower fly for the Columbia River, with a white stylised mountain in the green.
history: Vancouver is a city in Clark County, Washington, on the Columbia River opposite Portland. The flag, designed by Nathan Hunter and Brooke Nugent, was recommended by a community-led flag selection committee and adopted unanimously by the city council on 10 November 2025, with the formal flag-raising on 28 November 2025; it replaced the flag used since 1993.

features.role: blue lower fly for the Columbia River
